architecture_deltas_for_triggerword4.delta: Do not migrate stern.zulassen() as the canonical EntityOS EffectGate. Preserve its useful checks and journal shape, but place deterministic allow/deny/hold enforcement at the actual executor/host boundary. Lifecycle hooks may be adapters/auditors, not the sole effect authority when they fail open or emit no deny.

Split the overloaded donor effect status into typed, independently evidenced states: ADMISSION_DECISION, ENFORCEMENT_DECISION, EXECUTION_RECEIPT, WORLD_EFFECT_VERIFICATION, COMPLETION_EVIDENCE and CAUSAL_REENTRY. A single VERIFIED bit must never imply all six.

Bind every state-changing call with an immutable invocation_id/tool_use_id-equivalent to its effect_id. Do not correlate PreToolUse and PostToolUse through one mutable session slot. Require duplicate/reorder/parallel-call tests and exact mismatch rejection.
Make external effect outcome UNKNOWN a first-class state. Missing PostToolUse, cancellation, transport ambiguity or stale correlation cannot become VERIFIED and cannot trigger blind replay.
Downstream GWT/GRID intent-vs-effect logic must consume typed world-effect verification and causal re-entry, not effects.status='VERIFIED' alone.

preserved_contradictions.resolution: The normal donor zulassen path is pre-execution bookkeeping/assessment, not deterministic denial authority. The hook surface can deny in the separate SEBUKKU branch, proving that lack of denial in zulassen is an implementation choice rather than a host limitation.

The donor can mint VERIFIED from PostToolUse fallback without a PreToolUse row and later treat VERIFIED as aussenwirkung. Frankenstein 2.0 must structurally separate pre-admission from observed result.

preserved_contradictions.claim_a: Donor uses one active_turns.effect_id per session to correlate PreToolUse with PostToolUse.
preserved_contradictions.claim_b: Current host semantics provide per-call tool_use_id and permit concurrent PostToolUse for parallel tool calls.
preserved_contradictions.falsifier: A proven host-level serialization invariant for every state-changing call plus an executable correlation test showing the session slot cannot be overwritten/reordered; otherwise migrate to immutable per-call identity.
